findings.reason: correcting the island count to two removes a non-existent deliverable from the node's scope and stops the plan understating its own impl fraction.
findings.text: §3 still lists three host islands "blocking a compiled catalog verdict" and counts select_forward_branch as one, but that island is already closed: the host selector delegates to the traced array core (nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py:588-635) and §5 of the same plan states only two islands remain — a reader sizing the first implementation node from §3 prices work already landed

findings.reason: the node's "consume the existing smooth read unchanged" premise rests on the citation; a wrong pointer sends the implementer to the wrong function and the same §5 "no private attribute access" claim should be checked against the real symbol.
findings.text: the p_diverted citation points at nova/equilibrium/connectivity_boundary.py:877-886, which is compact_reachability code, whereas p_diverted is defined at connectivity_boundary.py:2424 and emitted at :2465 inside traced_smooth_boundary_read — a claim about prior art that does not survive opening the file

findings.reason: naming forward.py:704/828/1062 as the owner to make array-only (rather than a new kernel) is a one-line plan edit that prevents a forked seed path which would then drift from the production cold seed.
findings.text: island 1 ("seed construction becomes an array-only kernel") does not name the seed owner it must transform, and the seed path already has owners: cold_seed_portfolio (forward.py:704) and moment_seed (forward.py:828) built on ReconstructMoment.uniform_disc / centroid_disc plus the traced operator.current_moment_image, with the diverted cubic built at _saddle_geometry_seed (forward.py:1062) — a node can satisfy the plan by writing a parallel traced seed kernel and leaving the host one in place, which is the duplicate the item exists to prevent

findings.reason: naming fixed_point.py as the ladder to extend, and deleting the "bootstrap" term, removes an ambiguous deliverable and stops the node authoring a second ladder beside the shared one.
findings.text: island 3 ("the admitted-state bootstrap becomes a fixed ladder with device selection") names a subsystem the codebase does not carry: no symbol named bootstrap exists under nova/, while a shared device fixed-point ladder already exists (fixed_point.py; forward.py:1940 "Drive the map with the shared fixed-point ladder") — so the plan asks to build a ladder beside the shared owner

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — the selection seam is one module (nova/equilibrium/branch_selection.py) hiding transition, persistence, admissibility and degrade accounting behind a six-array TracedSelectionInput and a single step function, with the host SelectionReceipt as the egress boundary; that is depth, not surface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan's two remaining islands are named as kernels without binding them to the existing owners, so a node could fork a second seed path beside cold_seed_portfolio (forward.py:704) and a second ladder beside the shared fixed-point ladder (fixed_point.py).
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan searched the codebase and cites the mechanisms it extends (p_diverted, class_margin, ForwardProfile.solve_portfolio, branch_selection.py), but its §3 island inventory is stale against the code it names and its p_diverted line citation points at the wrong lines.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the remaining implementation (seed kernel, bootstrap ladder) extends forward.py and the existing ladder in place rather than adding a layer; the host select_forward_branch already delegates its transition semantics to the traced core (branch_selection.py:627) instead of duplicating them.
